Meet your host

The occasion is yours.
The microphone is Lester’s.

Working across Tagaytay and Cavite, Mark Lester S. Agellon is the events host and voice-over talent known as Lester Events Host.

His professional profile centers on a well-modulated voice and thoughtful program flow. His public event posts span wedding celebrations, Batangas Sabugan hosting, and an open-house event with Mavis Catering at Mahogany Place Tagaytay.
